metrics.name: pipeline_stage_table
metrics.plain: Each stage of the funnel (reach, sessions, page loads, product views, add to cart, checkout, orders, AOV, repeat, margin, cash) with today's value, your own trailing median, and stores-like-you's band
metrics.formula: current window value; trailing median of 4 prior windows; peer band from benchmarks filtered by store tags
metrics.source: metric contract, contract history, benchmarks file
metrics.window: current day/week vs 4 trailing windows of the same length
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after the window's last full day plus 1 day
metrics.unavailable_when: a stage's connector failed or has no full day of data
metrics.benchmark: store-type peer band, source dated in the benchmarks file

metrics.name: money_at_stake_top_break
metrics.plain: What the top broken stage is costing this week, in dollars
metrics.formula: (peer or own-trailing value - current value) x volume at the stage x downstream conversion to revenue
metrics.unavailable_when: the stage or a downstream stage is unreadable

metrics.name: goal_gap
metrics.plain: How far the current window sits from the founder's stated period goal, by stage
metrics.formula: goal value - current value, per stage
metrics.unavailable_when: no goal set for the period

metrics.name: gross_vs_net_orders
metrics.plain: Orders and revenue you actually keep, after expected returns and chargebacks, next to the gross number
metrics.formula: net = gross - (gross x expected return rate) - (gross x expected chargeback rate for the window); COD and prepaid split first
metrics.source: order data with payment method, RTO data by window
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 2 days without an RTO update
metrics.unavailable_when: payment method or RTO field missing
metrics.benchmark: India general-practice band: about 25-35% RTO, 58-65% COD share (general-practice basis, not this brand's proof)
metrics.markets_note: For COD markets, RTO (parcel never received, a subset of COD) is netted too and shown as its own leg; it reads null for US brands.

metrics.name: same_day_threshold_crossings
metrics.plain: Count of pre-agreed hard triggers crossed today
metrics.formula: count of live metric readings today where value crosses its stored threshold
metrics.source: live metric feed vs pre-agreed triggers table
metrics.freshness_rule: checked continuously through the trading day
metrics.unavailable_when: live feed not connected for that metric

metrics.name: pending_decisions_count
metrics.plain: How many cards are waiting for a decision right now
metrics.formula: count of registry entries with status = card_shown, not yet decided
metrics.unavailable_when: never; 0 is a valid value here

metrics.name: reads_due_count
metrics.plain: How many running experiments hit their read point this week
metrics.formula: count of registry entries where read_point falls within the current week
metrics.unavailable_when: never

metrics.name: trend_alert_count
metrics.plain: Stages that have moved the same direction for 2 windows running
metrics.formula: count of stages where delta sign matches for 2 consecutive trailing windows
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 full trailing windows exist

metrics.name: unreadable_stage_count
metrics.plain: Stages the system cannot honestly call healthy or broken today
metrics.formula: count of stages flagged unreadable by Diagnose
metrics.unavailable_when: n/a, this is itself the unavailable count

metrics.name: overlap_flag_count
metrics.plain: Running experiments that share an audience or metric window with another running experiment
metrics.formula: pairwise check of registry running entries for audience or window overlap
metrics.unavailable_when: an entry has no stored audience definition

metrics.name: cross_brand_rank
metrics.plain: Where this brand's top item ranks against every other brand the agency runs, today
metrics.formula: sort of each brand's top queue item by money at stake and time sensitivity on one scale
metrics.source: per-brand queues, per-brand money at stake
metrics.unavailable_when: a brand's money-at-stake is itself unreadable

metrics.name: brand_quiet_days
metrics.plain: Days since the founder last made a decision on this brand
metrics.formula: today - date of last decision log entry
metrics.unavailable_when: no decisions ever logged
metrics.benchmark: flag at 7+ days for an active brand

metrics.name: chargeback_rate
metrics.plain: Share of paid orders reversed through a card dispute in the window
metrics.formula: chargebacks opened / paid orders in window
metrics.unavailable_when: gateway disputes not connected
metrics.benchmark: under 0.9 percent to stay clear of card network monitoring programs

metrics.name: seasonal_deadline_countdown
metrics.plain: Days left before the nearest festival or sale window's prep deadline
metrics.formula: deadline date - today, per specialist prep item tied to the nearest calendar window
metrics.unavailable_when: no calendar window loaded

insights.name: top break named
insights.rule: highest-stake stage from Diagnose, ranked by stake then confidence then upstream position
insights.sentence: {stage} is costing about {amount} this {window}, since {date}

insights.name: trend alert
insights.rule: a stage's delta sign matches for 2 consecutive trailing windows
insights.sentence: {stage} has moved {direction} for 2 windows running
insights.severity: medium, shown under the top break

insights.name: Reversals widening
insights.rule: the gap between gross and net orders widens for 2 or more windows running
insights.sentence: Gross orders look flat but net orders after returns and chargebacks have fallen {pct} over 2 windows
insights.severity: high, separate from a demand bottleneck

insights.name: same-day trigger crossed
insights.rule: a live metric value crosses its stored hard threshold mid-day
insights.sentence: {metric} crossed its {threshold} trigger at {time} today
insights.severity: high, notified once per trigger per day

insights.name: experiment overlap
insights.rule: two running registry entries share an audience or metric window
insights.sentence: {idea_a} and {idea_b} share the same audience; the newer one is staggered

insights.name: brand gone quiet
insights.rule: brand_quiet_days exceeds 7 for a brand with an active queue
insights.sentence: {brand} has had no founder decision in {n} days while {m} cards wait
insights.severity: high, ranked ahead of a merely busy brand

insights.name: unreadable stage
insights.rule: a stage has no full day of data or a failed connector
insights.sentence: {stage} cannot be called healthy or broken: {source} has not reported since {date}

insights.name: external cause check
insights.rule: a metric move coincides with a dated external event (platform change, gateway outage, courier strike, festival date shift)
insights.sentence: {stage} moved {pct}, but {event} on {date} may explain part of it
insights.severity: medium, shown before crediting a fix

insights.name: reads due this week
insights.rule: registry entries whose read_point falls in the current week
insights.sentence: {n} experiments hit their read point this week

insights.name: seasonal prep at risk
insights.rule: a specialist's pre-window prep item has fewer days left than its own stated lead time
insights.sentence: {item} is due in {n} days for {window} and is not yet marked ready

insights.name: single-item escalation
insights.rule: an incoming escalation is below the crisis threshold but above the normal queue bar
insights.sentence: {item} needs a look today; it is not a crisis but it is not routine either
insights.severity: medium, distinct from full crisis mode

insights.name: chargebacks rising
insights.rule: chargeback_rate rises 2+ windows running or crosses 0.9 percent
insights.sentence: Chargebacks reached {rate} percent of paid orders, up {delta} in {n} windows; representment and the reason codes are in the Money room

visuals.name: stage waterfall
visuals.shows: each pipeline stage with the break marked and the money at stake labelled
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder sees exactly where the funnel narrows more than it should, in one look

visuals.name: stake bar
visuals.shows: money at stake per stage, ranked
visuals.why_this_chart: ranks breaks by size so attention goes to the biggest one first

visuals.name: top 10 card stack
visuals.shows: the top 10 proposal cards with why-now, effect, effort, risk and 3 buttons each
visuals.why_this_chart: matches the action plan pattern already built for Gehna, so a decision takes seconds

visuals.name: trend sparkline row
visuals.shows: each stage's last 5 windows, flagging the 2-window-running movers
visuals.why_this_chart: shows direction without needing a full chart per stage

visuals.name: cross-brand rank list
visuals.shows: every brand's top item on one scale of stake and urgency, brand-tagged
visuals.why_this_chart: an agency account manager needs one list, not N tabs to compare by hand

visuals.name: same-day alert ticker
visuals.shows: triggers crossed today with time and metric
visuals.why_this_chart: surfaces a mid-day event without waiting for tomorrow's batch read

actions.label: Approve, reject or park by text reply
Send me a voice-note brief instead

not_elsewhere.claim: money-at-stake per stage, computed in code from your own trailing history and a peer band, before any fix is proposed
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify Analytics and Klaviyo dashboards show revenue, sessions and conversion rate, not a stage-level stake number with a peer band

not_elsewhere.claim: gross orders shown net of expected returns and chargebacks and split by payment method before naming a bottleneck
not_elsewhere.vs: generic ecommerce dashboards report gross orders only; no packaged Shopify or Triple Whale view nets out India RTO by default

not_elsewhere.claim: one ranked list across every brand an agency runs, by stake and urgency on the same scale
not_elsewhere.vs: AgencyAnalytics and Whatagraph give per-client reports and roll-ups, not a single cross-client priority queue

not_elsewhere.claim: same-day alert on a pre-agreed hard trigger, separate from full crisis mode and from tomorrow's batch ranking
not_elsewhere.vs: most ecommerce dashboards check once a day; ads and analytics platforms alert on their own metrics only, not a founder-defined cross-channel trigger

not_elsewhere.claim: approve, reject or park a specific card by a single SMS or Slack reply, matched back to its card id
not_elsewhere.vs: SMS tools like Attentive and Postscript handle customer-facing templates and support replies, not an internal founder decision channel tied to a proposal card

not_elsewhere.claim: a test flagged before it starts if it shares an audience or metric window with one already running
not_elsewhere.vs: enterprise experimentation platforms like GrowthBook check this inside one engineering team's own test list, not across marketing ideas drawn from a bank, an audit and the web

data_needs.connector_or_script: SMS platform API; WhatsApp Business API for brands that use it (markets IN)

founder_view_note: With nothing connected, the room shows unavailable for every stage and says which connector each one needs; the cross-brand list, messaging row and same-day ticker simply do not render until those sources exist. The first thing to appear once the metric contract has 5 full days of history is the pipeline waterfall with the top break named; the top 10 cards follow once Propose has run once.

metrics.name: section_freshness
metrics.plain: Days since each brain section last collected or crawled
metrics.formula: today - last successful collection date, per section
metrics.source: connector pull log, site crawl log
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after each source's own agreed cadence (daily for orders and spend, weekly for competitors and voice)
metrics.unavailable_when: a source has never successfully collected

metrics.name: confidence_tier_counts
metrics.plain: How many claims sit in each tier: approved, site-backed, forbidden, untiered
metrics.formula: count of claims by tier
metrics.freshness_rule: recomputed on every crawl or founder answer
metrics.unavailable_when: never
metrics.benchmark: n/a; untiered should trend to 0 within 7 days of appearing

metrics.name: open_questions_count
metrics.plain: How many gaps or conflicts are waiting on a founder answer
metrics.formula: count of open question records with no founder answer
metrics.unavailable_when: never
metrics.benchmark: n/a; a founder-question round triggers at 4+

metrics.name: conflict_count
metrics.plain: Facts where a document and the site (or two connectors) disagree
metrics.formula: count of unresolved conflict records
metrics.freshness_rule: recomputed on every crawl or extraction
metrics.unavailable_when: never

metrics.name: site_diff_count
metrics.plain: Products, prices, stock, policy or claim changes since the last crawl
metrics.formula: count of diffs between the last two site snapshots
metrics.unavailable_when: crawl failed

metrics.name: connector_health_pct
metrics.plain: Share of connected sources that reported successfully in their own cadence
metrics.formula: successful pulls / expected pulls, per source, rolled up
metrics.unavailable_when: a connector was never granted

metrics.name: contract_renewal_countdown
metrics.plain: Days left before each vendor or platform contract renews or its rate card expires
metrics.formula: renewal_date - today, per contract
metrics.unavailable_when: a contract has no stored renewal date (flagged incomplete)
metrics.benchmark: alert sized to how long a renegotiation takes for that vendor type

metrics.name: legal_disclosure_pass_rate
metrics.plain: Share of live pages, policies and invoice templates carrying the required US disclosures
metrics.formula: pages passing all required checks / pages checked
metrics.freshness_rule: checked on every page or template change
metrics.unavailable_when: a page has not been checked yet
metrics.benchmark: target 100%, any fail blocks the page

metrics.name: marketplace_parity_flags
metrics.plain: Listings where price, content or stock diverge from the brand's own D2C data, by marketplace
metrics.formula: count of listing fields differing from the brand's stated price, stock and approved claims
metrics.source: marketplace snapshot vs brand's own price and stock
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days without a snapshot
metrics.unavailable_when: a marketplace connector is not granted
metrics.benchmark: n/a; any MAP violation is a flag regardless of size

metrics.name: permission_coverage_pct
metrics.plain: Share of brain sections with an assigned permission table entry
metrics.formula: sections with an explicit permission entry / total sections
metrics.freshness_rule: recomputed when a section, person or role is added
metrics.unavailable_when: never
metrics.benchmark: target 100%; a section with no entry defaults to restricted, not open

metrics.name: competitor_snapshot_age
metrics.plain: Days since each tracked competitor's ads, site and price were last captured
metrics.formula: today - last snapshot date, per competitor
metrics.unavailable_when: a competitor was never captured

metrics.name: voice_sheet_examples_count
metrics.plain: How many liked, disliked and site-backed examples back the current voice sheet
metrics.formula: count of tagged voice examples
metrics.unavailable_when: no examples tagged yet

insights.name: claim untiered too long
insights.rule: a claim has sat untiered for more than 7 days
insights.sentence: {claim} has been untiered for {n} days and needs a founder call

insights.name: source conflict
insights.rule: a document fact and the live site disagree on the same field
insights.sentence: {document} says {value_a}, the site says {value_b}; the site wins by default until you say otherwise

insights.name: site changed unnoticed
insights.rule: a price, stock, policy or claim diff appears between two crawls
insights.sentence: {field} changed from {old} to {new} on {date}

insights.name: connector failing
insights.rule: connector_health_pct falls under 90% for a source over its own cadence
insights.sentence: {source} has missed {n} of its last {m} expected pulls; its fields show unavailable, not zero

insights.name: contract renewal approaching
insights.rule: contract_renewal_countdown falls inside the alert window sized for that vendor type
insights.sentence: {vendor} renews in {n} days; last terms were {rate} agreed on {date}

insights.name: contract missing renewal date
insights.rule: a stored contract has no renewal date field
insights.sentence: {vendor}'s contract has no renewal date on file and is marked incomplete

insights.name: disclosure missing
insights.rule: a live or about-to-ship page fails a required US disclosure check
insights.sentence: {page} is missing {disclosure}; this blocks going live

insights.name: MAP violation
insights.rule: a marketplace listing price sits below the brand's stated minimum advertised price
insights.sentence: {marketplace} lists {product} at {price}, below your {map_price} minimum

insights.name: unauthorized reseller
insights.rule: a marketplace listing's seller name does not match the brand's own account
insights.sentence: An unrecognised seller is listing {product} on {marketplace}

insights.name: permission gap
insights.rule: a brain section has no assigned permission entry
insights.sentence: {section} has no permission set and defaults to restricted

insights.name: competitor snapshot stale
insights.rule: competitor_snapshot_age exceeds 7 days
insights.sentence: {competitor} was last captured {n} days ago

insights.name: founder question round due
insights.rule: open_questions_count reaches 4 or more, or one open question blocks a running item
insights.sentence: {n} open questions are waiting; it is time for a founder round

visuals.name: freshness x confidence heatmap
visuals.shows: each brain section on freshness (rows) against confidence tier (columns)
visuals.why_this_chart: one look shows what is both stale and untrustworthy, the worst combination

visuals.name: claims tier bar
visuals.shows: count of claims by tier: approved, site-backed, forbidden, untiered
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder sees at a glance how much of the brand's messaging is actually locked down

visuals.name: decisions log timeline
visuals.shows: founder decisions with reason and date, most recent first
visuals.why_this_chart: reasons in a list are hard to scan; a timeline shows the pace and pattern of founder calls

visuals.name: conflict table
visuals.shows: each unresolved conflict, source A value versus source B value, with the site marked as current default
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder needs to see both claims side by side to resolve one, not a summary

visuals.name: contract renewal calendar
visuals.shows: each vendor contract's renewal date with the alert window marked
visuals.why_this_chart: renewals are date-driven; a calendar view is the only honest way to show what is coming

visuals.name: permission matrix
visuals.shows: brain sections (rows) against roles or people (columns) with view rights marked
visuals.why_this_chart: a matrix is the standard, checkable shape for who-sees-what

visuals.name: marketplace parity strip
visuals.shows: brand's own price versus marketplace price versus MAP line, per SKU with a flag
visuals.why_this_chart: mirrors the site-diff pattern so marketplaces get the same rigor as the D2C site

actions.label: Draft the renewal or rate renegotiation
Flag this reseller or MAP violation

not_elsewhere.claim: claims tiered approved, site-backed or forbidden, tied to red lines and forbidden-claim detection, not generic content staleness
not_elsewhere.vs: Guru, Slite and MangoApps flag stale or unowned pages, but they tier general company docs, not ecommerce product and marketing claims against founder-set red lines

not_elsewhere.claim: a conflict between a document and the live site resolved with a stated default (the site wins) rather than left for a person to notice
not_elsewhere.vs: enterprise wikis surface drift for a human to review; none apply a default-winner rule between two specific source types automatically

not_elsewhere.claim: marketplace listings diffed against the brand's own price, stock and claims the same way the D2C site is crawled
not_elsewhere.vs: MAP-monitoring tools exist for large brands on Amazon, but nothing in this stack ties marketplace diffs to the same claims-tier and site-diff pipeline as the brand's own site

not_elsewhere.claim: vendor and platform contracts extracted into renewal alerts sized to how long a renegotiation takes, inside the same brain as everything else about the brand
not_elsewhere.vs: generic contract-management SaaS tracks renewal dates but is not fed from or feeding the same brand brain a founder already uses for decisions

not_elsewhere.claim: US legal disclosure gate (FTC, CAN-SPAM, CCPA privacy policy, sales tax on invoices, return policy, auto-renewal) checked before a page ships, as a blocking check, not a general CMS compliance plugin
not_elsewhere.vs: generic CMS and Shopify legal-page apps exist, but they are not tied into this brand's own claims tiers and decisions log

not_elsewhere.claim: a permission map enforced the same way whether a person opens the brain directly or asks a question in chat
not_elsewhere.vs: role-based access in most knowledge tools governs direct reads only; it is not applied to an AI chat answer drawing from the same sections

data_needs.refresh: on new document; continuous for alerts

founder_view_note: With no connectors granted, every section shows unavailable with the connector it needs, and the freshness x confidence heatmap is blank except for anything pulled from the site crawl, which needs no connector grant. The first thing to appear is the claims tier bar once the site is crawled once; contract renewals and marketplace parity appear only after those specific data sources are added.

metrics.name: running_count
metrics.plain: How many ideas are currently running for this brand
metrics.formula: count of registry entries with status = running
metrics.unavailable_when: never

metrics.name: reads_due_this_week
metrics.plain: How many running entries hit their read point this week
metrics.formula: count where read_point falls within the current week
metrics.unavailable_when: never

metrics.name: stale_entries_count
metrics.plain: Entries past their read point with no result recorded yet
metrics.formula: count where today > read_point and result is null
metrics.unavailable_when: never

metrics.name: parked_count
metrics.plain: How many ideas are parked, and how many have an expiring reason
metrics.formula: count of status = parked; subset where expiry date <= today
metrics.unavailable_when: never

metrics.name: result_distribution
metrics.plain: Share of read results that were up, down, flat or unreadable
metrics.formula: count by result value / total results in window
metrics.unavailable_when: no results yet in window

metrics.name: brand_prior_effect
metrics.plain: This brand's own updated effect size for an idea, after being tried here
metrics.formula: weighted average of this brand's own recorded results for the idea, most recent weighted higher
metrics.source: registry, per-idea history for this brand
metrics.unavailable_when: idea never tried on this brand (falls back to bank basis, tagged general-practice)

metrics.name: founder_weight_table
metrics.plain: The standing weights the ranker applies, built from repeated founder reasons
metrics.formula: reason-to-weight mapping, fixed table, updated when a reason repeats
metrics.unavailable_when: never, defaults to neutral weight until a pattern repeats

metrics.name: overlap_count
metrics.plain: Pairs of running entries sharing an audience or metric window
metrics.formula: pairwise overlap check across running entries
metrics.unavailable_when: an entry has no stored audience

metrics.name: prediction_accuracy_pct
metrics.plain: How often the predicted founder decision matched the actual one
metrics.formula: matches / total predictions made
metrics.source: LOOP-C36 prediction log vs decision log
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 10 predictions made
metrics.benchmark: stop showing the prediction if it performs no better than chance

metrics.name: retro_completion_rate
metrics.plain: Share of closed initiatives that got a retro
metrics.formula: initiatives with a retro note / initiatives closed
metrics.unavailable_when: no initiatives closed yet

metrics.name: read_point_sizing
metrics.plain: Whether each running entry's read point is sized to the metric's own noise, not a fixed day count
metrics.formula: flag where read_point duration falls below the minimum days needed for that metric type per LOOP-C08
metrics.unavailable_when: never
metrics.benchmark: 60-180 days for slow metrics, days for fast ones, per the standard

metrics.name: handoff_ready_count
metrics.plain: How many areas have an exportable, plain-language decision history ready for a new person
metrics.formula: count of areas with a generated handoff export in the last 90 days
metrics.freshness_rule: generated on demand or on personnel change
metrics.unavailable_when: never

insights.name: read point reached
insights.rule: today equals or passes an entry's read_point
insights.sentence: {idea} on {brand} hit its read point; result is {up_down_flat_unreadable}: {number}
insights.severity: high, this is the core loop event

insights.name: stale unread entry
insights.rule: today exceeds read_point by more than a few days with no result recorded
insights.sentence: {idea} passed its read point {n} days ago with no result recorded yet

insights.name: parked reason expired
insights.rule: a parked entry's stored expiry date has passed
insights.sentence: {idea} was parked because '{reason}'; that reason has now expired

insights.name: unreadable result
insights.rule: a read point landed but required data is missing
insights.sentence: {idea}'s read is unreadable: {field} is missing, not zero

insights.name: overlap collision
insights.rule: two running entries share an audience or metric window
insights.sentence: {idea_a} and {idea_b} collide on {dimension}; stagger one

insights.name: repeated reject reason becomes weight
insights.rule: the same founder reason appears 3 or more times against similar idea attributes
insights.sentence: '{reason}' has come up {n} times; ideas like this now rank lower automatically

insights.name: ranked pick versus prediction mismatch
insights.rule: the code ranker's top card and the predicted founder decision disagree
insights.sentence: The top-ranked card is a likely {predicted_decision} based on your past reasons; it is shown anyway

insights.name: read point too small

visuals.name: registry kanban
visuals.shows: entries grouped by status: running, waiting, parked, done, with brand tags for an agency view
visuals.why_this_chart: matches how a founder already thinks about work in flight, and groups the one thing that matters, status, first

visuals.name: read point timeline
visuals.shows: upcoming and overdue read points across all running entries
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder or specialist needs to see what is coming due without opening each entry

visuals.type: small multiples of sparklines per idea
visuals.shows: how the brand's own effect estimate for an idea has moved across repeated attempts
visuals.why_this_chart: shows the brand's own learning curve on a specific idea, not a generic bank average

visuals.name: overlap matrix

visuals.name: founder reason weight chart
visuals.shows: the most common founder reasons and the ranking weight each has earned

not_elsewhere.claim: a per-brand prior effect size for a marketing idea, built only from what happened when this brand tried it, separate from the bank's brand-agnostic basis
not_elsewhere.vs: GrowthBook, Eppo and VWO run and score individual A/B tests but do not carry a cross-idea, cross-attempt brand memory tied to a founder-facing idea bank

not_elsewhere.claim: a founder's repeated approve, reject or park reason turned automatically into a ranking weight, without being asked to restate it
not_elsewhere.vs: decision logs in Notion or similar tools store the reason as text; nothing turns a repeated reason into a scoring input for the next similar idea

not_elsewhere.claim: an overlap check across marketing ideas from a bank, an audit and the web, not just inside one engineering team's own test list
not_elsewhere.vs: GrowthBook's namespace collision checks cover its own hosted experiments, not ideas gathered from three different sources with different owners

not_elsewhere.claim: the same retro shape (what worked, what did not, would we do it again) applied automatically to any closed initiative type: launch, crisis, onboarding, replatform
not_elsewhere.vs: most retro tools are generic templates a team fills in by hand per project; nothing here triggers automatically from a registry close event and files the answer as a reusable checklist

founder_view_note: With no ideas approved yet, the room shows an empty kanban with a note that nothing is running, and the founder reason weight chart stays empty until at least 3 decisions repeat a pattern. The first thing to appear is the registry kanban itself, populated the moment the first card is approved; brand priors and the prediction check only build up after a few read points land.

metrics.name: weekly_headline_metric
metrics.plain: The one number that moved most this week and by how much
metrics.formula: largest absolute percent change among headline contract fields, week over week
metrics.freshness_rule: windows end on the last full day
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 2 full weeks of history

metrics.name: shipped_vs_blocked_count
metrics.plain: How many approved items shipped this week versus how many are blocked
metrics.formula: count of registry entries moved to status=running or done this week; count stuck with a blocker note
metrics.unavailable_when: never

metrics.name: okr_progress_pct
metrics.plain: Progress toward each key result this quarter
metrics.formula: current value of the tied metric contract field / target value
metrics.unavailable_when: the tied metric field is unavailable

metrics.name: monthly_client_metrics
metrics.plain: The core metrics a client report shows: spend, ROAS, orders, revenue, by brand
metrics.formula: period totals and rates from the metric contract
metrics.freshness_rule: generated after month close, full days only
metrics.unavailable_when: a field's connector failed during the month

metrics.name: portfolio_capacity
metrics.plain: Queue depth per agency person against their available hours, across every brand they work on
metrics.formula: sum of estimated hours for open queue items per person / stated available hours
metrics.unavailable_when: a person's available hours are not on file

metrics.name: invoice_match_rate
metrics.plain: Share of invoice lines matched to a delivered artefact in the registry
metrics.formula: matched lines / total invoice lines
metrics.unavailable_when: the registry has no artefact record for that period

metrics.name: sow_cadence_adherence_pct
metrics.plain: How closely an agency or freelancer's actual delivery cadence matches their stated scope-of-work commitment
metrics.formula: delivered items in period / committed cadence in the SOW
metrics.window: each period defined in the SOW
metrics.unavailable_when: no SOW terms on file

metrics.name: agency_report_discrepancy_count
metrics.plain: How many numbers in an agency or platform's own report do not match the metric contract
metrics.formula: count of headline figures in the report differing from the matching contract field beyond a rounding tolerance
metrics.source: agency or platform report, metric contract
metrics.unavailable_when: the report's window cannot be matched to a contract window

metrics.name: operating_cadence_load
metrics.plain: How many standing recurring reviews the founder is expected to sit through
metrics.formula: count of active standing reviews on the cadence calendar
metrics.freshness_rule: reviewed quarterly or on specialist add
metrics.unavailable_when: never
metrics.benchmark: flag when it grows past what a solo founder can sit through

metrics.name: board_update_readiness
metrics.plain: Whether this quarter has enough recorded wins, misses and numbers to draft a board update
metrics.formula: count of registry results plus contract headline fields available for the quarter
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 1 recorded result for the quarter

metrics.name: channel_headroom
metrics.plain: Estimated room left in each channel before returns drop, feeding next month's budget split
metrics.formula: per-channel headroom estimate from each specialist, marginal return curve
metrics.source: MEDIA, ORG, LIFE specialist headroom estimates
metrics.unavailable_when: a channel's specialist has not produced an estimate

insights.name: one number that moved most
insights.rule: largest absolute percent change among headline fields this week
insights.sentence: {field} moved {pct} this week, mostly from {cause}
insights.severity: always shown first in the weekly review

insights.name: metric out of band 2+ weeks
insights.rule: a metric sits outside its normal band for 2 consecutive weeks
insights.sentence: {field} has been outside its normal range for 2 weeks running

insights.name: OKR off track
insights.rule: okr_progress_pct is behind the pace needed to hit the target by quarter end
insights.sentence: {key_result} is at {pct} with {weeks} weeks left; on pace to miss

insights.name: SOW under-delivery pattern
insights.rule: sow_cadence_adherence_pct falls short for 2 or more periods running
insights.sentence: {vendor} has delivered under its committed cadence for {n} periods running

insights.name: invoice line unmatched
insights.rule: an invoice line has no matching delivered artefact in the registry
insights.sentence: {invoice_line} on {vendor}'s invoice has no matching delivered work on file

insights.name: agency report window mismatch
insights.rule: an agency report's stated date range differs from the contract's matching window
insights.sentence: {vendor}'s report uses {their_window} while our contract measures {our_window}; the numbers are not directly comparable

insights.name: agency metric not in our vocabulary
insights.rule: a reported metric has no matching field in the metric contract
insights.sentence: {vendor} reports '{their_metric}', which likely stands in for {our_field}

insights.name: person over capacity
insights.rule: portfolio_capacity exceeds 100% for a person this week
insights.sentence: {person} is booked at {pct} of available hours across {n} brands this week

insights.name: cadence overload
insights.rule: operating_cadence_load exceeds what a solo founder can sit through
insights.sentence: The standing review calendar now has {n} recurring meetings; consider retiring one

insights.name: channel drifted from agreed split
insights.rule: a channel's actual spend share has moved from the last agreed allocation beyond a set tolerance
insights.sentence: {channel} spend has drifted to {pct} of budget versus the {agreed_pct} last agreed

visuals.name: weekly one-pager
visuals.shows: headline number, what shipped, what is blocked, decisions needed this week
visuals.why_this_chart: matches the 5-minute-read shape the capability itself commits to

visuals.name: OKR progress bars
visuals.shows: each key result against its target, pace-adjusted
visuals.why_this_chart: progress bars show distance to target at a glance, with the pace line marking on-track versus behind

not_elsewhere.claim: a weekly review that names the one number that moved most and why, tied to the registry's reads due and the decision log, not a static KPI list
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's own weekly dashboards and apps like Second Founder show revenue, orders, sessions and AOV, but do not tie the read to what is running in an experiment registry

not_elsewhere.claim: a portfolio capacity heatmap showing hours booked per agency person across every brand they touch
not_elsewhere.vs: AgencyAnalytics and Whatagraph report campaign performance per client; neither shows a person's booked hours across the brands they serve

not_elsewhere.claim: an agency or platform's own report reconciled line by line against the brand's own source-of-truth metric contract, with window mismatches and vanity metrics named
not_elsewhere.vs: reporting tools display what a platform or agency sends; none of them independently recompute and compare it to a separate source of truth

not_elsewhere.claim: scope-of-work cadence tracked over multiple periods, not just whether one invoice matches one deliverable
not_elsewhere.vs: invoicing and project tools check a single invoice against a single delivery; a repeated under-delivery pattern across periods is not a built-in check

not_elsewhere.claim: a standing meeting cadence that is itself reviewed for overload as the specialist set grows, rather than fixed once and left alone
not_elsewhere.vs: calendar and meeting tools schedule what is put in; none of them flag when the cadence itself has outgrown what a solo founder can sit through

founder_view_note: With no registry activity yet, the weekly one-pager still generates from the metric contract alone, naming the one number that moved most, and simply shows zero for shipped and blocked. The client report and portfolio heatmap need at least one full reporting month and an agency roster on file before they render; until then the room shows what each needs to switch on.
